Burial Practices
In megalith culture , there were two types of burial practices Fractional / Partial & Complete / Extensive burial practices . Fractional / Partial Burial Practice : Under fractional burial practice , the selected bones of dead person were buried in the grave . It seems that they left the dead person in open space vere the fleshes of dead person were eaten by birds and animals , and after that the remaining bones were selected and placed in the grave . This burial practice ´was very prevalent in Megalith Culture .
